title: Filipino Taro Bilo Balls
description: A traditional Filipino snack made with taro and bilo. The combination of textures and flavors is a perfect representation of Filipino cuisine. These crispy fried balls are a delicious treat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine grated taro and bilo. Mix well.
Add all-purpose flour, salt, and water to the mixture. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into small balls. You should end up with around 20-25 balls.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few taro bilo balls to the pan and fry until golden brown.
Remove the fried balls from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Filipino Taro Bilo Balls warm or at room temperature.
